messages:
Maya: Postmortem thread for the 2025-11-12 latency/throughput incident. TL;DR: repeated evening throughput spikes + KV cache misses caused 95th pct gen latency to cross 800ms for ~18m. Running items and owners below; please ack and set ETA.
Sanjay: Thanks — sharing initial action list from postmortem doc: 1) dashboard panels for error budget burn by region; 2) autoscaler tuning for p99 throughput bursts; 3) persistent KV cache perf regression root-cause; 4) rollout gating for quantized models. Who wants 1/2/3/4?
Liam: I'll take #1 — dashboard panels + alert thresholds. ETA EOD Tue. Will add panels in grafana and create queries for per-route token rate and latency.
Maya: @Liam awesome. Please make sure to include per-model variants (v1/v2/quant) so we can see fallback hits.
Liam: ack. Using this query snippet for panel:
```
sum(rate(requests_total{env="prod"} [1m])) by (route, model_variant)
```
Will add 95p latency panel next.
Carla: I'll own #3 (KV cache regression). Plan: reproduce in staging, capture flamegraphs, check memory eviction behavior. ETA Fri COB.
Eva: I'll own #2 (autoscaler). Proposal: reduce scale-up cooldown from 300s to 90s for GPU pools during peak windows, and add scale-out based on request queue length. Posting proposed HPA YAML in PR.
Sanjay: For #4 (rollout gating), ops must block quantized model rollouts during error budget deficit periods. Can we codify that in rollout policy? @Maya
Maya: Yes — adding a canary gating policy to rollout service. New policy: if monthly error budget used > 20% in last 24h, prevent automatic rollouts. I'll draft policy by Thu.
Liam: Quick Q: what's our current error budget window? Is it 30d with 3% latency breaches? Someone confirm.
Maya: Current: 30d window, 1.5% allowed p95>300ms breaches for hosted tier. We burned ~2.1% during the event.
Carla: Suggestion: add a short-term SLA relaxation for known noisy routes, instead of global SLO change. E.g., create sub-SLOs per route for chat vs embeddings.
Sanjay: Good call. Action: create sub-SLOs for top 5 routes. Owner: @Maya. ETA next Wed.
Maya: Confirmed. I'll open SLO ticket and link to postmortem.
ops-bot: Created ticket REDWOOD-5912 and added to backlog. Link: https://jira.redwood/REDWOOD-5912
Liam: Also adding alert: alert if error budget burn rate > 0.5% per 6h sliding window. Will push to alerting repo.
Eva: FYI: I'll run a 4-week canary with adjusted autoscaler and measure p95 and cost delta. Starting Monday.
Carla: One more: recurring pattern seems evening-Pacific spike. Can we add scheduled capacity bump 18:00-22:00 PST for 2 weeks as mitigation? Owner: @Eva. ETA before Mon rollout.
Eva: ack, scheduling.
Maya: Meeting: follow-up sync Friday 10:00 PT to review dashboards and ticket statuses. Please update Jira tickets before meeting.
Sanjay: ack :thumbsup:
Liam: ack :eyes:
Carla: ack
Eva: ack
Maya: thanks all — file notes in postmortem doc and close loop after the Friday sync.
